limitations: All candidates fail security admission. Source scans cover exact owned build inputs and their locks, not every repository file.

Full image layers and private keys are not retained. In-run OCI closure and transfer observations are source bound; this retrieval independently rechecks retained manifest signatures and small-file digests only.
Fresh ephemeral development keys do not establish operated signer identity/custody, independent SLSA assurance, registry promotion or G01 acceptance.
